verdict.rationale: The Node SDK exposes a `validate` VAT-number function (taxjar-gh-5), showing some tax-ID validation capability, but there is no evidence of real-time official registry checks or of reverse-charge logic being applied for B2B cross-border sales — and TaxJar positions itself as built for businesses that 'only sell in the US' (taxjar-docs-18, taxjar-docs-24), undercutting the cross-border VAT use case. Missing for 10: documented reverse-charge handling, registry-backed real-time VAT/tax-ID validation, and any EU/cross-border B2B tax compliance features.
